item.title: Historic Rome Courthouse destroyed by fire | WGAA Radio
item.description: By: Sam Branch (WGAA Radio) One of the most recognizable and historic buildings in Rome was destroyed on Monday afternoon. At around 2:15pm, fire sparked at the historic Floyd County courthouse, completely destroying the Rome landmark. The building had been undergoing renovations for several weeks and work was in progress The post Historic Rome Courthouse destroyed by fire first appeared on WGAA Radio.
